title: CBW Claim, Evidence and Freshness Model V1
auditCorrection: Owner Audit Correction 026: separated freshness, claim-verification and source-health vocabularies; replaced claim-type-agnostic tier authority with a predicate-specific authority matrix.
description: Canonical claim/evidence graph and freshness governance. Architecture model only; example ids and the example.invalid domain are placeholders, not live sources.

claimTypeAuthorityMatrix.note: regulator, legislation, court or official register governs; an exchange statement does not override a regulator.
official exchange documents govern operational product/fee/KYC claims.
the bank/provider that supplies the rail governs, corroborated by exchange evidence.
official incident notice plus independent security reporting where available.
leads/signals only until corroborated by a higher-authority family for that claim type.

authorityRule: There is NO universal 'higher tier always wins' rule. Conflict resolution selects the primary authority for the claim's predicate from claimTypeAuthorityMatrix. All evidence is retained; an unresolved critical conflict yields taskOutcome CONFLICT_UNRESOLVED and no agent silently drops contradictory evidence.

fields.predicate: one of [REGULATORY_STATUS, LICENSE, RESTRICTION, REGISTRATION, KYC, PRODUCT_AVAILABILITY, PAYMENT_RAIL, FEE, LIMIT, SECURITY, HISTORY, AFFILIATE_OFFER]
fields.statementText: concise factual statement, not marketing prose
fields.limitations: string; required for confidence LOW/UNVERIFIED or verificationState UNDER_REVIEW/UNSUPPORTED
fields.isCritical: boolean; regulatory, security, sanction, restriction claims are critical

invariants: verificationState and freshnessState are independent dimensions and MUST NOT be conflated
a claim with no non-contradicted supporting evidence has verificationState UNSUPPORTED and confidence at most LOW
a critical claim that is STALE or EXPIRED, or UNDER_REVIEW/UNSUPPORTED, MUST trigger publication suppression

fields.sourceType: one of [OFFICIAL_SITE, HELP_CENTER, REGULATOR_REGISTER, RSS, API, NEWS, COMMUNITY]

invariants: snapshot bytes live in object storage, never in the DB or Git
an OPEN conflict on a critical claim holds publication and, if unresolved, yields CONFLICT_UNRESOLVED
versions are append-only; superseded versions are retained, never deleted

fields.freshWindow: ISO-8601 duration, e.g. PT1H or P3D

FreshnessPolicy.note: Durations are ISO-8601 so sub-day intervals (minutes/hours) are supported, not integer days only.

legacyMappings.note: Old value AGING is retained here only as a migration mapping and is not a current value.
